    Filter lakes

    Basin, river and type come from the inventories that carry them (CWC, Nepal, Bhutan), and vulnerability rank from the CWC critical lakes. A lake without that attribute is hidden while the filter is set. The 56 NDMA critical lakes carry none of them.

    About the data

    Lake data: your GeoJSON (56 NDMA critical lakes). CWC Glacial Lakes (2,802 lakes) and CWC Critical Glacial Lakes (40 lakes, ranked by vulnerability): your CWC GeoJSON files; areas are in hectares. Nepal glacial lake inventory 2023 (2,578 lakes) and Bhutan glacial lake inventory 2026 (620 lakes): your GeoJSON files, shown as one point per lake and switched on or off in the panel or the layer control. State boundaries: your State_Boundary file, simplified for display. District boundaries: your district file (Survey of India), simplified for display. Imagery: Google Hybrid, Esri World Imagery, EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless (10 m), OpenTopoMap. Place search: OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Flow tracing runs on the DEM you load. Straight-line distances only; this is a screening aid, not a hydraulic assessment.
